thread:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert: service=runtime-engine severity=high — multiple CrashLoopBackOffs observed in eu-west (pods restarting due to SIGSEGV) :rotating_light:
harper_oncall: Oncall Harper here, acknowledging. I'll start triage and notify SRE/runtime.
leo_runtime: picking this up. quick glance at pod logs shows segfault in trt_plugin_fused during kernel launch. snippet:
```
2026-03-14T07:21:03Z runtime[pid=7812]: load kernels: fused_attention,fast_gemm
2026-03-14T07:21:03Z runtime[pid=7812]: vllm_fused::invoke_kernel+0x4f
2026-03-14T07:21:03Z runtime[pid=7812]: ERROR: SIGSEGV at 0x7ffd3ab2e in trt_plugin_fused.cpp
2026-03-14T07:21:03Z runtime[pid=7812]: cudaGetLastError(): device-side assert triggered
```
ana_sre: node checks: ip-10-9-33-77 shows repeated `NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:3d:00): 31` and dmesg entries `kernel: kernel NULL pointer dereference in module nv`. suspect GPU driver/kernel mismatch on 535.14.
priya_cs: Impact: CS reporting surge in 5xx for EU customers; tickets 18 open, 2 enterprise. I'll post a brief customer-facing status and flag enterprise AEs.
harper_oncall: mitigation plan: 1) stop fused variant to prevent noisy restarts 2) reroute EU traffic to cpu fallback 3) cordon problem nodes 4) collect cores and trt/nvlogs 5) escalate infra for driver rollback if confirmed. Assign lead to @leo_runtime.
leo_runtime: scaling fused deployment down: `kubectl -n prod scale deploy runtime-engine-fused --replicas=0` — done.
diagnostics-bot: action: cordon node ip-10-9-33-77.prod (hosts 4 crashloop pods).
leo_runtime: updating routing: setting region policy to prefer cpu-fallback for eu-west via `runtime-router` config. patch: ```bash
kubectl -n prod set env deploy/runtime-router EU_PREFERRED_VARIANT=cpu-fallback
```
ana_sre: collecting artifacts: deployed privileged daemonset to gather /var/crash/*, core.* and `nvidia-bug-report.log`. uploading to s3://redwood-incidents/1857654321/artifacts. Enabled `ulimit -c unlimited` in debug container.
priya_cs: CS update drafted: "We're aware of increased errors in EU, mitigation in progress. We'll provide technical summary and ETA shortly." Sending now.
leo_runtime: starting canary with disabled fused kernels: image runtime-engine:v1.3.5-disable-fused — 1 pod in eu-west started, no segfaults seen after 45s.
harper_oncall: good. If canary holds for 5m, roll to remainder with autoscaler paused. If not, we may need to rollback driver or pin TRT plugin.
ana_sre: capturing full `nvcrash` and plugin logs from cordoned node before reboot. grabbing `gdb` backtrace from one core and `gcore` of helper process when it's alive.
leo_runtime: note: earlier CI had TRT plugin 8.4.x tests, but production had 8.3.1 pinned; suspect edge-case with quantized kernels and sequence length 4096. adding reproduction matrix.
diagnostics-bot: traffic policy applied: region eu-west -> cpu-fallback (policy id rp-2026-03-14-07).
ana_sre: metrics: eu-west error rate dropped from 48% -> 7% over 6 minutes after routing change; P50 increased by ~12ms.
priya_cs: notifying affected customers with mitigation note and offering follow-up call for enterprise accounts.
harper_oncall: piling up artifacts and assigning follow-ups: ENG-RT-742 to runtime (repro + patch fused kernels), INFRA-3901 to infra (driver matrix and rollback plan), and OPS-1190 for improved canary gating.
leo_runtime: rolling out disabled-fused to remaining pods (pause HPA). progress: 7/10 pods ready; monitoring logs closely.
ana_sre: added temp readinessProbe delay 10s to avoid instant restarts and allow gcore capture.
priya_cs: CS update 2: mitigation successful for now; customers seeing reduced errors. ETA for full recovery 20-40m pending rollout completion.
harper_oncall: handoff: @leo_runtime will take active lead, I'll remain incident coordinator. Alex from infra paged via INFRA-3901.
diagnostics-bot: incident timeline entry created: incident-1857654321. artifacts: s3://redwood-incidents/1857654321/artifacts ; tickets: ENG-RT-742, INFRA-3901, OPS-1190.
leo_runtime: canary stable at +12m, full rollout complete in eu-west. monitoring for 30m recommended. No new SIGSEGVs in logs post-rollout.
ana_sre: leaving nodes cordoned until infra completes driver verification or reinstalls stable driver. filed note to infra on-call.
priya_cs: scheduling customer follow-up email and technical RCA once postmortem done.
harper_oncall: wrapping up: page closed for oncall rotation, handover to SRE rotation. Good work. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: Incident mitigated: traffic rerouted, fused kernels disabled, artifacts collected. Monitoring for 24h.
